verdict.rationale: LegalZoom advertises 'Unlimited eSignatures—1 year included' as part of its LLC package, confirming an e-signature capability exists, but there is no documentation describing multi-recipient routing, signing order, or workflow management for sending to multiple parties. Missing for 10: details on multi-recipient routing/order, confirmation of legally binding compliance standards (e.g., ESIGN/UETA), and any independent/hands-on verification of the e-signature flow.
